title: Crash on startup when the config file is empty
body:
### What happened

Running `widget serve` with an empty `widget.toml` crashes immediately.

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "widget/cli.py", line 44, in main
    cfg = load(path)
KeyError: 'listen'
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. `touch widget.toml`
2. `widget serve`

Expected a helpful error but got a KeyError.

title: Support for YAML config files
body:
It would be nice to read `widget.yaml` as well as `widget.toml`. Steps to reproduce not applicable — this is a feature request.

```yaml

```
